request: Hey Claude, I just added the "programmatic-seo" skill. We make an invoicing app for small service businesses. Should we build "[trade] invoice template" pages for the 40 trades we serve, which ones first, and what should the page template look like?
data_owned_per_variable: a ready-made invoice preset per trade in the app (fields and line items)
aggregated, anonymised invoice data by trade: common line items, typical invoice value, payment terms, days to get paid
goal: start a free account with the trade preset loaded
data_pulled: serp_google_organic: contractor, plumbing and tutoring invoice template
labs_ranked_keywords: invoicefly.com folder (300 of 1261 rows), tofu.com folder (77 rows)
onpage_instant_pages and onpage_content_parsing: two invoicefly.com trade pages
not_used: google-search-console (no site for the example business)
